label: v53.65
changes: Fixed the Couldn’t open yet regression caused by creating a fresh private cache and then deleting older saved workshop bundles during repair
Navigator now searches every previous pn-private-bundle cache and upgrades any valid saved workshop copy into the current v53.65 visual runtime
Changed the private workshop cache to one canonical cache so visual releases no longer strand an offline device by rotating cache names
Repair now clears only frontend shell/module caches and deliberately preserves all private offline Navigator bundles
Initial startup now prefers an existing verified saved workshop copy instead of forcing a live network fetch every time
Restored dual live bundle recovery using navigator-bundle-v52 first and navigator-bundle-safe second
The v53.64 Nova visual overhaul remains intact; shared task state, DONE history, assignments, holds and Morning Pack data are not reset
